method: Reviewed each displayed sentence and all four choices item by item, independently determining the required main-clause conditional form before comparing with the stored key/explanation. Checked unique-answer validity, sentence naturalness, target-skill fit, distractor plausibility, time-reference consistency, and explanation consistency. The persisted candidate format co-locates keys with stems, so strict technical answer-blinding cannot be guaranteed in this connector-only path; no item was approved without individual review.
notes: All 25 items have a single defensible main-clause form given the conditional context: real future conditions take will + base verb, present/future hypotheticals take would + base verb, and unreal past conditions take would have + past participle. Sentence naturalness, temporal consistency, distractor plausibility, target-skill fit, and stored explanation consistency were checked item by item. Full cross-bank semantic near-duplicate clearance remains outstanding.
